class PeerProducerBase220 { public string $text; public function __construct($text) { $this->text = $text; echo 'CTOR;'; } public function __invoke($saved, $marker) { $this->text = $saved; echo 'INVOKE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo 'THIS-END;'; } } class PeerProducerChild220 extends PeerProducerBase220 {}
class PeerBase220 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $kept; $kept = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } } class PeerDerived220 extends PeerBase220 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived220; $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $receiver = null; $receiverAlias =& $receiver; $kept = null;
$result = $owner->MiSsInG(first: peerInstall220(), later: ($receiver(...))($late, peerShift220()));
echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept->text, ';'; unset($kept); unset($receiverAlias); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
